Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

We are the team defining the future of packaging of complex memory systems! Our Package pathfinding and Architecture organization sits at the intersection of silicon, packaging, systems, and customer needs—turning complex scaling challenges into technologies that power next generation platforms, through cutting edge packaging technologies. If you enjoy working on problems with real industry impact, look no further!

Key Responsibilities

Partner with System Architects and engineering teams to define package architecture, connectivity, and electrical requirements.
Develop block diagrams, schematics, and logical connectivity for system-in-package designs.
Create and verify package netlists using schematic and automation-based design flows.
Support ASIC/package co-design, including pad/bump maps, connectivity, and package integration.
Evaluate package designs for electrical performance, manufacturability, reliability, and system requirements.
Collaborate with Package Design and SI/PI teams to support physical and electrical implementation.
Support integration of memory, ASICs/controllers, and other devices within complex package architectures.
Support new and evolving interfaces such as LPDDR/DDR, ONFI, UFS, PCIe, and other high-speed protocols.
Lead technical reviews and resolve package connectivity and integration issues through design, validation, and product bring-up.
Develop technical documentation and provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineering teams.
Work with TPM and factory teams to develop design rules roadmap for packaging across all memory and ASIC roadmaps
Support improvements in package integration, design methodology, verification, and automation.
Support new protocol enablement (SCA-Separate Command Address, ONFI, UFS, PCIe) and capability bring-up.
Support debugging of root cause and failures in reliability tests by electric failure analysis (EFA) and Physical Failure Analysis (PFA) and strive for resolution and improvements through multi-functional team partnership.
Experience and/or interest in developing Agentic AI workflows into current or future processes. 

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical engineering or a related field with 10+ years of experience,
Proven experience in hardware design and development, including block diagrams, schematics, and electrical requirements.
Strong understanding of system architecture and the ability to work collaboratively with System Level Architects.
Familiarity with NAND flash memory technology, controller design, and storage system behavior.
Proficiency in EDA schematic and simulation tools such as Cadence Allegro System Capture, Synopsys Design Compiler, Mentor Graphics PADS, Altium Designer, and OrCAD.
Experience with ASIC architecture in storage products (e.g., SSD, eMMC, UFS, USB) and high-speed serial and parallel interfaces (e.g., PCIe, MIPI, DDR, LPDDR, ONFI).

Preferred Skills

Experience in semiconductor package design, architecture, or integration.
Experience with schematics, netlists, connectivity definition, and verification.
Understanding of ASIC/package and System-in-Package integration.
Knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, and package electrical design.
Familiarity with memory and high-speed interfaces such as DDR/LPDDR, ONFI, UFS, and PCIe.
Experience with EDA tools for schematic capture, package design, or connectivity verification.
Familiarity with advanced packaging, substrate technologies, and assembly processes.
Strong cross-functional technical leadership and problem-solving skills.
